name: systemsbyvega
description: Systems by Vega — territory catalog and Site Shop. Static site, no build step. This file exists ONLY so middleware.js can import @vercel/functions. Do NOT add "type": "module" — tools/build-catalog.js (the Vercel buildCommand), api/demand.js, api/digest.js and api/owner.js are CommonJS and the flag breaks the build. Extensions already carry the distinction: .mjs is ESM, .js is CommonJS.
